79613045.title: Alla Bruletova
79613045.extract: Alla Bruletova (born 15 September 1999) is a Russian model, blogger and TikTok creator. In July 2023, she received prominence for a video she published with Bentley for a Jet Car dealership.

79633701.title: Arianna Rivas
79633701.extract: Arianna Rivas is an American actress. She is known for co-starring in the film A Working Man alongside Jason Statham.

33259487.title: Ayumi Ishida (singer)
33259487.extract: Ayumi Ishida (石田亜佑美, Ishida Ayumi) (born 7 January 1997) is a Japanese singer. She is a former tenth-generation member and sub-leader of the pop group Morning Musume.

47419695.title: Ayça Ayşin Turan
47419695.extract: Ayça Ayşin Turan (born 25 October 1992) is a Turkish actress best known for her roles in Meryem, Arıza, and Ada Masalı, for which she won a Golden Butterfly Award.

79448203.title: Celina Weil
79448203.extract: Celina Weil (born 6 December 2000) is a German model and beauty pageant winner who was crowned Miss Deutschland in 2024.

13497242.title: Chisato Okai
13497242.extract: Chisato Okai (岡井 千聖, Okai Chisato) (born June 21, 1994, in Saitama, Japan) is a former Japanese pop singer, actress, model, and television personality. She first gained recognition when she joined Hello!

79662175.title: Daniela Lalita
79662175.extract: Daniela Lalita; born 1992 as Daniela Czenstochowski is a Peruvian musician, model, and artist. Around the age of 19, she moved to the United States to study apparel design at the Rhode Island School of Design and did several internships in the fashion industry.

79386276.title: Demi Sims
79386276.extract: Demi Sims (born 6 September 1996) is an English television personality. She appeared on The Only Way Is Essex in 2014, between November 2018 and July 2022, and in late 2024.

27734919.title: Ella Purnell
27734919.extract: Ella Summer Reed Purnell (born 17 September 1996) is a British actress. She began her career as a child actress in West End theatre and films, including Never Let Me Go (2010), Intruders (2011) and Maleficent (2014).

80043677.title: Firsta Yufi
80043677.extract: Firsta Yufi Amarta Putri (born March 1, 2001) is an Indonesian model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Puteri Indonesia 2025. She represented Indonesia at Miss Supranational 2025 in Poland, where she reached the top 24 and won the title of Miss Supranational Asia & Oceania 2025.

47962788.title: Mawra Hocane
47962788.extract: Mawra Hussain (born 28 September 1992), known professionally as Mawra Hocane, is a Pakistani actress who primarily works in Urdu television. She made her acting debut in 2011 with Khichari Salsa.

80047878.title: Melliza Xaviera
80047878.extract: Melliza Xaviera Putri Yulian (born May 21, 1999) is an Indonesian general practitioner, and beauty pageant titleholder who won Puteri Indonesia Lingkungan 2025. Melliza previously competed in the Abang None Jakarta 2019 competition and was selected as the main winner.

79423483.title: Như Vân
79423483.extract: Nguyễn Đình Như Vân (born 5 December 1991) is a Vietnamese model and beauty pageant titleholder, She was crowned Miss Global Vietnam 2024 and is the first Vietnamese to be crowned Miss Global 2025 in Thailand.

36869220.title: Nicole Bahls
36869220.extract: Nicole Mariana Bahls (born 15 November 1985) is a Brazilian model, actress and television presenter.

81928276.title: Pattraphus Borattasuwan
81928276.extract: Pattraphus Borattasuwan (born 27 January 2004), formerly Pussarasorn Bosuwan, nicknamed Bonnie, is a Thai actress under GMMTV and a singer signed to Riser Music. She began her acting career portraying Peeta in the 2024 television series High School Frenemy, which earned her the 2025 Mint Award for Rookie of the Year.

39550131.title: Sol Rodríguez
39550131.extract: María Soledad Rodríguez Belli, known by her stage name Sol Rodríguez, is an Argentine actress and model, known for playing Mecha in the Nickelodeon Latin America's series Grachi, as Teresa Ramirez in the second season of Star Trek: Picard, and as Sasha Bordeaux in the second season of Peacemaker.

28725231.title: Suzuka Morita
28725231.extract: Suzuka Morita (森田 涼花, Morita Suzuka; born September 7, 1992 in Yamashina-ku, Kyoto, Japan) is a Japanese actress and voice actress. She was a 7th generation member of Hop Club and a 2nd generation member, number 11, of Idoling!!!.

38947906.title: Tara Teng
38947906.extract: Tara Oi-kwan Teng (born August 17, 1988), is a Canadian former pageant winner. She was crowned Miss Canada 2011 and also Miss World Canada 2012.

79667676.title: Valentyna Zhytnyk
79667676.extract: Valentyna Zhytnyk (born October 1, 1992) is a Ukrainian jewelry designer, gemologist and former top model based in New York. She is a beauty pageant titleholder, having been crowned Miss Ukraine Earth 2010, and represented Ukraine at Miss Earth 2010 in Hanoi, Vietnam.

79653784.title: Winta Zesu
79653784.extract: Winta Zesu (born November 1, 2000) is an Ethiopian model, influencer, YouTuber and actress. She rose to prominence through her satirical rage-bait content on TikTok and YouTube, where she portrays a comedic videos.
